score_error: Euclidean norm of score-vector difference / Euclidean norm of MG257 score vector, separately at each nested prefix
spot_reference_gate: At all 32 fixed spot sites jointly, MC standard-error vector norm / norm(MG257) <= target/4 and norm(MCmean-MG257)/norm(MG257) <= target/4 + 2*relative_MC_SE. These are diagnostics, not rigorous confidence bounds.
zero_reference: unresolved if reference norm is zero or nonfinite
bootstrap: 10000 pointwise bootstrap resamples of five paired seeds, RNG seed 20260917; mean per-seed relative error and mean measured wall time; no simultaneous or selection-adjusted inference
eligibility: Reference gates pass and upper 97.5th bootstrap percentile of mean score error <= target
winner: Fastest eligible tested budget by mean wall time within each method. Missing eligible methods are reported as not reaching the target, not assigned infinite speedup.
speedup: mean multigrid cumulative time / mean TWoS cumulative time, with pointwise paired bootstrap interval for selected configurations; descriptive after budget selection
unchanged_domain: Additional-batch times are measured after prior queries; MG's solved fields are retained. Prefix totals include initial solve and all subsequent batches. Mesh loading is reported separately.
edited_domain: Prefix times start after insertion of one fixed cavity, forcing MG field rebuild; common outer mesh stays retained. No unmeasured interactive speed claim.
